supplies.VDD,VDD_TX: 2.6-5.5 V (-40..105 C), 2.4-5.5 V (-20..105 C); with sup3V bit set max 3.6 V (DS p144). Default after power-up is 5 V mode: firmware must set sup3V for a 3.3 V supply (DS p38)

supplies.transmit: antenna current is set by the matching; internal VDD_RF regulator limits at 350 mA rms (DS p39). Budget the 3.3 V rail for this

logic.can_run_1V8: yes: VDD_IO down to 1.65 V; set io_drv_lvl=1 below 3.3 V and for all I2C (DS p73, p145, p151)
logic.interface_select: pin I2C_EN: GND = SPI, VDD_D = I2C (DS p51, p57)
logic.spi: mode 1 (CPOL 0, CPHA 1), MSB first, up to 10 Mbit/s (DS p1, p51)
logic.i2c: address 50h (DS p56; drawn as 7 address bits, so 0x50 7-bit - confirm on the bench); standard 100 kHz, fast 400 kHz, fast-plus 1 MHz, high-speed 3.4 MHz (DS p56, p151); bus load max 100 pF in the table on p151
logic.irq: ACTIVE HIGH CMOS output at VDD_IO (DS p51, p57)
logic.reset: no reset pin; power-on reset, then direct command Set default (C0h/C1h) (DS p60)

to_brain: IRQ(27): needs a real interrupt-capable pad (see conflicts)
to_expander: nothing required; a load switch on VDD/VDD_TX is optional because power-down is about 1-2 uA
antenna: Printed loop, differential drive RFO1/RFO2 through EMC filter + matching; not a 50 ohm port and not shareable with other radios. Keep clear of battery/copper (AN5276 p20).
notes: Architecture doc says SPI; the pin plan puts NFC on I2C_U with touch, keyboard and codec. I2C mode is real and selected by I2C_EN to VDD_D. Every FIFO byte then crosses a shared 400 kHz bus (512-byte FIFO).

Pin plan has NO pad for the NFC interrupt. IRQ is active-high push-pull; the wake pads are 1.8 V open-drain active-low, so it cannot be wired to one directly (needs an N-MOSFET inverter with pull-up, or VDD_IO = 1.8 V plus inverter, or an expander input).
I2C address 50h is the usual address of small EEPROMs: none may share I2C_U.
Pins 2 and 25 are test outputs TAD1/TAD2 on the B part (the older ST25R3916 had CSO/CSI there, and ST board schematics still use those labels).

Planned antenna is about 40 x 30 mm; ST values above are for 47 x 34 mm 4 turns, so treat every matching value as a starting point and keep all positions (series, parallel, damping, RX divider) populated-by-choice.
AAT varicaps are optional; without them fit fixed capacitors only (as Flipper does).
